meta.title: An evaluator who is not a buyer: open the Technical stage
gaps: Prove that award and withdraw are denied specifically because the user is an evaluator rather than because of the event's current state
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Prove that award and withdraw are denied specifically because the user is an evaluator rather than because of the event's current state

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed Technical stage and a vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Open the Technical stage where evaluation is performed.
Sign in as the assigned evaluator, score the technical response, and submit the evaluation.
Check that the current evaluator view does not offer the Withdraw action.
Check that the evaluator view does not expose the award action.
